title: PSYЯEN

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the episode's creative use of the power system, action, worldbuilding, and cooperation-focused premise.
Amamiya's competence and the evolving group dynamics were well received.
Some viewers found the episode entertaining and stronger than earlier installments, while others felt the adaptation lacked characterization and atmosphere.
A minority considered the episode boring and said they might stop watching.
Some criticized the newcomers' implausibly poor decisions and questioned parts of the episode's tactical logic.

notes: The title and embedded episode label match Psyren episode 5. I read 20 substantive comments from this thread only. Spoilers were excluded from the sentiment summary; animation and sound were not clearly discussed by several comments.
